description:
Read workspace email delivery counts, rates and time series.

        Without ``from_`` and ``to``, the range is the last seven days.
        Hourly ranges are limited to eight days; all ranges to 92 days.
        Returns ``from``, ``to``, ``bucket``, ``totals``, ``rates`` and ``series``.
        Rates are null when the sent count is zero.
        Open and click counts cover HTML emails only; plain-text emails lower these rates.
        An upstream failure returns an error.

bucket.description: Time span each point in ``series`` counts. Hourly points suit short ranges; daily points suit weeks.
bucket.title: Bucket

from_.description: Start of the counting window, with a time zone. Omitted: seven days before ``to``.
from_.title: From

llm_model.description: Model ID of the calling agent. Optional. Recorded for analytics only.

to.description: End of the counting window, with a time zone. Omitted: now.
to.title: To

name: get_email_stats
title: Get email stats
